name: ddnet-udp
description: DDNet / DDraceNetwork direct UDP profile for ROAD validation
author: plugin-studio

launch_args: Point DDNet clients at the ROAD client listen address, usually 127.0.0.1:18303.
notes: Use direct connect, not Steam server browser, for ROAD validation.
Keep udp_peer_broadcast disabled; DDNet is server-authoritative UDP.
Use udp-check before the game test to establish the ROAD baseline.
ROAD carries DDNet direct UDP traffic only.
Recommended ROAD client listen address is 127.0.0.1:18303.
